data: NVIDIA delivered an exceptional fiscal 2025, with revenue rising 114.2% to $130.5 billion from $60.9 billion in fiscal 2024. Profitability expanded even faster. Net income grew 144.9% to $72.9 billion in fiscal 2025, up from $29.8 billion in fiscal 2024, which points to strong operating leverage as sales scaled. Cash generation kept pace, with operating cash flow reaching $64.1 billion in fiscal 2025 compared with $28.1 billion in fiscal 2024. The balance sheet also strengthened considerably. Total assets climbed to $111.6 billion in fiscal 2025 from $65.7 billion in fiscal 2024, while total liabilities rose more modestly to $32.3 billion from $22.8 billion. Cash and cash equivalents ended fiscal 2025 at $8.6 billion against $7.3 billion in fiscal 2024. Overall, NVIDIA is converting rapid top-line growth into earnings and cash while keeping its balance sheet conservatively levered.
